item.title: EP01: Lodge Cast Iron
item.description: The 130-year-old Tennessee company behind America's most famous skillet: a teenage founder who walked 1,200 miles, the fire that burned it all down, the garden gnomes that saved the Great Depression, and the invention of pre-seasoned cast iron. This show is for entertainment and curiosity only, and nothing here is investment advice.
